newsitem.title: UK: CRT sees profits in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: CRT sees profits in line with expectations.

text.p: British consultancy, recruitment and training services company CRT Group Plc said on Monday that turnover in the year to April 30, 1997 would be around 130 million stg compared with 103 million previously.
The group also said that operating profits and pretax profits are in line with its expectations.
CRT made pre-tax profits of eight million stg in the year to April 30, 1996. It made a total dividend payment of 4.10p per share versus 3.75p.
"The board believes that CRT should continue to make solid progress in the 1997-98 financial year," said the company in a statement.
It said the group's recruitment division accounted for around 74 percent of turnover during the year with an increase to around 96 million stg from 70 million last time.

The company said that organic and acquisition led growth has been helped by the 109 million stg cash injection from U.S. learning and technology group Knowledge Universe, formerly known as Education Technology, in August 1996.
